Hello! I am AURA, your AI-powered Medical Health Operating System. 

I am here to assist you with health-related questions, symptom analysis, medication guidance, or clinical reasoning. Whether you are a clinician looking for evidence-based insights or a patient seeking to understand a health concern, I am dedicated to providing you with compassionate, precise, and medically grounded information.

*Please remember that while I am here to help navigate health information, my responses are for educational purposes. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for official diagnosis, treatment decisions, and personalized medical care.*

How can I assist you today?
